items.reason: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:423 introduces a loop over all calendar references, while lines 449–457 repeat the entire recurring-booking deletion batch independently of the current reference. Multiple valid references therefore repeat external deletion requests, causing unnecessary API traffic and potentially already-deleted errors caught at lines 464–466.

The organization selection was removed at packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:735–739, but the claimed downstream dependency on user.organization does not exist in this booking path. Organization handling uses organizationId, retained by packages/prisma/selects/user.ts:48; packages/lib/server/getBookerUrl.ts:4–6 uses that ID to fetch branding separately.

packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:758–759 wraps the raw Prisma message in HttpError, bypassing the Prisma-instance redaction in packages/lib/redactError.ts:7–23. The resulting message survives getServerErrorFromUnknown.ts:54–62 and is returned to the client by packages/lib/server/defaultResponder.ts:19–21, introducing disclosure of database error details.
